trial_court: Senior Civil Judge and JMFC, Bhalki - M.C.No.35/2021
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioner-wife seeks to withdraw M.C.No.35/2021 from Senior Civil Judge and JMFC, Bhalki and transfer it to Principal Judge, Family Court, Bidar. Petitioner is a young lady aged about 26 years with a female child aged about 02 years. Respondent-husband has filed petition seeking divorce on grounds of cruelty and desertion.

legal_principles.principle: The ends of justice should demand the transfer of the suit, appeal or other proceeding.
legal_principles.held: The cardinal principle for exercise of power under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure is that the ends of justice should demand the transfer of the suit, appeal or other proceeding.
cited_cases: N.C.V. AISHWARYA VS. A.S.SARAVANA KARTHIK SHA, (2022) SCC OnLine SC 119

legal_principles.principle: The convenience of the wife needs to be considered in transfer petitions.
legal_principles.held: In transfer petition, where the transfer is sought by the wife, the convenience of wife needs to be considered as held by Apex Court in catena of judgment in line.
cited_cases: N.C.V. AISHWARYA VS. A.S.SARAVANA KARTHIK SHA, (2022) SCC OnLine SC 119

outcome.final_order: Petition to withdraw M.C.No.35/2021 from Senior Civil Judge and JMFC, Bhalki and transfer it to Principal Judge, Family Court, Bidar is allowed.
